summary: Part B of Fix 2 complete. analytics.js: claims now include work_sessions from T.ov.work_sessions[task_id]. costflow.js splitSessionTokens: uses sum of closed work_session durations (start_ts→end_ts) when available, falls back to firstSeen/lastChanged window for legacy tasks. Both files syntax-clean.

subject: Fix 2: Token-delta work_sessions attribution model
description: Replace time-window token splitting with exact measured deltas. At start_task: read cumulative output token count from the session transcript, record as tokens_at_start on a new work_sessions entry (alongside git_user, agent_id). At complete_task/stale-release: read again, record tokens_at_end, compute contribution=tokens_at_end - tokens_at_start. Update splitSessionTokens in lib/costflow.js to use work_session deltas when available, falling back to time-window for legacy tasks. Depends on Fix 1 being in place.
